treelawn_find.eval: game.teleport(407, undefined, -110, 0); game.cameraOverride = (dt, c) => { c.position.set(407, 120, -108); c.lookAt(407, 0, -110); return true; };
treelawn_find.report: (() => { const G = game.city.roadGraph, M = game.groundMask, out = []; if (!M) return 'no mask'; for (const e of G.edges) { if (out.length >= 6) break; const P = e.pts; if (!P || P.length < 2 || e.elevated) continue; const m = P[P.length >> 1]; if (Math.hypot(m[0] - 407, m[1] + 110) > 75) continue; for (let i = 0; i < P.length - 1 && out.length < 6; i++) { const a = P[i], b = P[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (L < 12) continue; const dx = (b[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (b[1] - a[1]) / L, nx = -dz, nz = dx, hw = e.width / 2; for (const sd of [-1, 1]) for (let t = 0.3; t < 0.8; t += 0.25) { const x = a[0] + dx * L * t, z = a[1] + dz * L * t, at = (o) => M.debugRead(game, x + nx * sd * o, z + nz * sd * o); const c = at(hw + 0.15), g = at(hw + 1.3), s = at(hw + 3.4); if (c && g && s && c[1] > 128 && g[1] < 40 && g[0] < 40 && s[1] > 128) { out.push({ x, z, nx: nx * sd, nz: nz * sd, dx, dz, hw, e: e.id }); break; } } } } window.__tl = out; return out; })()

treelawn_1.eval: const t = (window.__tl || [])[0]; if (t) { const ex = t.x + t.nx * (t.hw + 3.2) - t.dx * 7, ez = t.z + t.nz * (t.hw + 3.2) - t.dz * 7; game.cameraOverride = (dt, c) => { c.position.set(ex, 1.75, ez); c.lookAt(t.x + t.nx * (t.hw + 1.2) + t.dx * 6, 0.1, t.z + t.nz * (t.hw + 1.2) + t.dz * 6); return true; }; }
